header.text: A statement tells about something. It ends with a period.

sentences.text: A lamb is a baby sheep.

An exclamation is like a statement, but it shows surprise or strong feeling. It ends with an exclamation point.

header.text: A command tells someone to do something. Most of the time, a command ends with a period. If it shows strong feeling, it ends with an exclamation point.
